paper.title_en: Orlov-Schulman symmetries of the self-dual conformal structure equations
paper.abstract_en: We construct Orlov-Schulman symmetries for the self-dual conformal structure (SDCS) hierarchy. An explicit proof of the compatibility of additional symmetries with the basic Lax-Sato flows of the hierarchy is provided, and several simple examples, including Galilean transformations and scalings, are considered. We also present a picture of the Orlov-Schulman symmetries in terms of a dressing scheme based on the Riemann-Hilbert problem.
